Describe the observed problem, the resulting behavior, and any debt deferred.
Link the actual discussion/review finding if this change responds to feedback.

## Quality gate

- [ ] A fixed defect has a regression test that exercises the original failure.
- [ ] Extracted sentences still match their original note and source reference.
- [ ] Extraction references cannot transfer between different drafts.
- [ ] New notes and stale versions block outdated review/approval.
- [ ] Technician additions remain distinguishable from extracted text.
- [ ] Approval is explicit, categorized, persisted, and immutable.
- [ ] Authentication, team boundaries, CSRF, and input limits remain intact.
- [ ] The full note → draft → review → approval workflow was checked.
- [ ] Tests, coverage, and security checks passed on this exact commit.
- [ ] AI-assisted changes were inspected; passing tests are not the only review.
- [ ] Documentation states actual results and any remaining limitations.
